mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 4.5%, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad-based economic expansion, generating stronger positive S&P 500 returns than either indicator alone over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO and HOUST both rising) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During early post-recession recovery (NBER recession ended June 2009), a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by at least 0.1 percentage point signals improving labor conditions that drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the early post-recession recovery regime, when UNRATE declines by at least 0.1pp, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strengthening consumer demand that precedes corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth rate is positive in the prior month, but 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 signals economic contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate investment and earnings.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 100, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate monetary tightening during strong labor market conditions, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to recession risk.
regime_hint: monetary tightening during strong labor market
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening residential construction activity that precedes broader economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: HOUST growth rate is positive in the prior month, but 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
